interventions.detail: Used uv-managed Python 3.11 venv because torchaudio<2.1 has no Python 3.12 wheels
Pinned numpy<2 for torch 2.0.x ABI compatibility
Pinned setuptools<81 since torch 2.0.x imports pkg_resources
apt-get install ffmpeg to decode mp3 input
Pre-downloaded htdemucs weights via demucs.pretrained.get_model from outside /work to avoid the repo dir shadowing the package
